title: Cloudflare R2 Maven Repository Guide
summary: How Kromium packages are published to Cloudflare R2 and how downstream projects configure their Maven / Gradle builds.

sections.title: Overview & Architecture
sections.content:
Kromium publishes standard Maven repository layouts directly to Cloudflare R2 under https://repo.daviante.org/artifacts.

### Benefits of Cloudflare R2
- **Zero Egress Fees:** $0 for outbound data transfer.
- **S3-Compatible API:** Operates seamlessly with standard build tools.
- **Edge Caching:** Fast global distribution via Cloudflare's CDN.

sections.title: Configuring Downstream Projects
sections.content: To consume Kromium artifacts in downstream Gradle or Maven projects, add the repository URL to your repository configuration.
